$comment: AI Posture criterion IRI registry. Stable IRIs: never re-mint, only supersede. Source: docs/assess/data/rubric.json. One criterion per vector per maturity level 1-5. Level 0 (N/A) is a falsifiable scope boundary, not a test criterion.

criteria.assertion: Our people use AI. We have not measured how.
evidence: Written acknowledgment of AI use in policy, dated.

criteria.assertion: We have looked at how our people collaborate with AI.
evidence: Baseline behavioral assessment of human-AI collaboration, dated.

criteria.assertion: What we saw changed what we do.
evidence: At least one policy or practice change traceable to baseline assessment data.
criteria.test: Show the change and the source finding.

criteria.assertion: We measure continuously. Data drives governance.
evidence: Cohort-level behavioral data on defined cadence.
criteria.test: Produce cohort report, cadence document, anonymization validation.

criteria.assertion: Human-AI collaboration is an engineered capability, continuously maintained.
evidence: Declared framework-review cadence with review artifact from prior cycle.
criteria.test: Show continuous assessment, attestation mechanism, declared cadence, and most recent review artifact.

criteria.assertion: Agents may interact with our systems. We have not measured readiness.
evidence: Acknowledgment that agents may interact with org systems.

criteria.assertion: We have scanned our infrastructure for agent readiness.
criteria.test: Produce scan report, surface inventory, partner map.

criteria.assertion: We have acted on what the scan showed.
evidence: Machine-readable declarations deployed (llms.txt, structured data, agent-legible identifiers).
criteria.test: Show scan, remediation log, follow-up scan delta.

criteria.assertion: We scan continuously. Drift is tracked.
evidence: Outer-surface claims verified against internal reality on a cycle.
criteria.test: Produce cadence record, drift log, claim-reality reconciliation.

criteria.assertion: Agent-readiness is engineered into how systems are built and shipped.
evidence: Standards contributed to, or internally extended protocols in use.
Declared framework-review cadence with review artifact from prior cycle.
criteria.test: Show release-gate evidence, standards contribution or internal extension, declared cadence, and most recent review artifact.

criteria.assertion: We are exposed to AI regulation. We have not mapped it.
We have mapped our obligations across jurisdictions.
evidence: Jurisdictional coverage across operations, sales, employment footprint.
criteria.test: Produce register with jurisdictional coverage and named gaps.

evidence: At least primary jurisdiction fully controlled.
criteria.test: Show the statute-to-control trace for at least one jurisdiction.

criteria.assertion: Controls cover all in-scope jurisdictions. Regulatory change is monitored.
evidence: Documented interpretations with counterparties where applicable.
criteria.test: Produce coverage map, monitoring cadence, interpretation records.

criteria.assertion: Compliance is continuous. New jurisdictions onboard rapidly.
evidence: Obligations met as measured coverage ratio, refreshed continuously.
Declared framework-review cadence with review artifact from prior cycle.
criteria.test: Show coverage refresh cadence, interpretation registry, jurisdiction-intake workflow, declared review cadence, and most recent review artifact.
